top_products.what_it_lacks: Contrive could benefit from more advanced analytics and reporting features, as well as better support for niche or proprietary apps. It also lacks a mobile app, which would be a huge convenience for users who need to access their work apps on-the-go.
top_products.ai_leverage: While Contrive does leverage AI models to power its search and automation features, it's clear that there's significant engineering and development that's gone into creating a cohesive and user-friendly experience. That being said, I do wonder if some of the features could be replicated using today's AI models, particularly the search function. However, the value that Contrive adds lies in its ability to integrate with a wide range of apps and provide a unified workflow, which would be difficult to replicate with raw AI models alone.
